navigationSource.warning: Archive includes later changes; selected instructions are corroborated by bounded original3.58f disassembly.

analysis: Ordinary bounded LLVM disassembly, not original Windows execution. No binary upload. Earlier REA evidence is retained; Hopper bridge was unavailable.

observations.fact: OB:T/U apply independent two-byte map-cell type/subtype fields; appearance is not rewritten by these operations.
GetVal(size2) sign-extends the stored short; the port stores low16 bits but returns signed values for queries.
UN:R dispatches mode1/2 to separate map/resource redraw routines; original campaign scripts contain10 mode1 and4 mode2 calls.

implementation: Map-local logical cell identities, guarded by disabled native default effects. Native source OB dispatch supports both real visitable objects and synthetic scenery cells.

Passable plot cells trigger after the hero enters; forced blocked plot cells trigger from the adjacent tile. Original current-hero and v998/v999/v1000 context are preserved, including pending save/reload.
Coordinate descriptions work even when native scenery is passable and non-visitable. Existing hero-specific descriptions retain priority.
UN:R1/R2 dispatch native redraw/resource updates without changing gameplay data. Native story forms keep stable DOM/scroll and separate source-authorized confirm/cancel actions.
limitations: Retyped plots with enabled native default effects, OB:C raw setup data, and native hero/monster/event/town class retyping remain unadmitted.
Original initialization/narrative readiness does not establish any original quest completion, combat or victory. Campaigns remain disabled.

Private diagnostic pauses used to localize the old UN:R stop were never added to published scripts or engine code. The recorded successful original-intro proof uses the unchanged original archive and script program, with private registry admission only.
